# historia-darunia-templo-rezagado, B: marks the cutscene played here at once (A's start is then ignored: 'is set here'), reads
# the steps, only watches while A plays it, and reads the steps again at the end (the target or later).
# Written by tools/harness/historias.py: change its table and run it again, do not edit by hand.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! switches LICHII_COOP_STORY=1
#! timeout 500
#! expect B coop: test flag HavePlayedEvent\.Demo_FireTemple_MeetAgainDarniaEvent \(0x[0-9a-f]{8}\) = 1 within after..flagged
#! expect B coop: story: STORY_EVENT start received from P\d \('Demo_FireTemple_MeetAgainDarniaEvent' in FireTemple\): ignored, HavePlayedEvent\.Demo_FireTemple_MeetAgainDarniaEvent is set here within flagged..end
#! never B coop: story: STORY_EVENT start received from P\d \('Demo_FireTemple_MeetAgainDarniaEvent' in FireTemple\): starting
#! never B coop: story: event running 'Demo_FireTemple_MeetAgainDarniaEvent' as P\d asked
#! expect B coop: story: FireTemple_Room02_CreateChain 0 -> 1 within asked..end
#! expect B coop: story: Step_SageOfFire \S+ -> GetBossKey within asked..end
#! expect B coop: test enum Step_SageOfFire \(0x[0-9a-f]{8}\): find_type -?\d+, value (GetBossKey|MeetBoss|DefeatBoss|GoToWarpPoint|Complete) \(0x within played..end
mark start
warp FireTemple EntrancePos adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
flag HavePlayedEvent.Demo_FireTemple_MeetAgainDarniaEvent 1
wait 30
flag HavePlayedEvent.Demo_FireTemple_MeetAgainDarniaEvent 1   # twice: a queued write may miss the frame the game applies
mark flagged
enum Step_SageOfFire
wait 570
mark asked
wait 8550       # only watches while A plays it
mark played
enum Step_SageOfFire
wait 600
mark end
